name: Motorcycle
description: A motor vehicle operated on two wheels: the road category for an electric two-wheeler too powerful or fast to be a motorized bicycle. A three-wheeler the rider straddles is a motortricycle, licensed and helmeted the same way.

restrictions.rule: Two wheels; a three-wheeled one the rider straddles and steers with handlebars is a motortricycle
An electric two-wheeler producing 3 gross brake horsepower (2,250 W) or more, or faster than 30 mph, is too much for a motorized bicycle
No limit on motor power or speed
A two-wheeler that isn't a road motorcycle, such as an off-road e-moto, is titled as a dirt bike instead
Riders need a license showing they passed the motorcycle exam
Riders and passengers under 26, and anyone riding on an instruction permit, must wear a helmet; local governments can't add a helmet rule
Titled and registered with the Department of Revenue, and the owner must maintain liability insurance
